page.metadataDescription: Prepare a private evidence request, compare signed provider quotations, and review exact supplied excerpts under a bounded quote budget.
page.heading: When the evidence you need is missing
page.introduction: Turn a gap in your research into a bounded request for new evidence.
page.noScript: JavaScript is required for this tab-memory workspace. No request is submitted on this page.

workspace.prepareAnEvidenceRequestCompareProviderQ: Prepare an evidence request, compare provider quotations, and inspect the exact evidence supplied for your decision.
workspace.workStaysInThisTabSMemoryAndIs: Work stays in this tab's memory and is lost on reload. Exports are private plaintext files: they contain your question, provider details and supplied text.
workspace.nameADecisionAndTheMissingFactsThatCould: Name a decision and the missing facts that could change it. Priority is your declaration, from 1 to 10.
workspace.whatDecisionAreYouTryingToMake: What decision are you trying to make?
workspace.replacingTheRequestClearsAllQuotationsDe: Replacing the request clears all quotations, deliveries, selections and reviews, because their signatures bind the original request.
workspace.aProviderPromisesADeliverableAndCoverage: A provider promises a deliverable and coverage. A valid provider signature authenticates that promise; it does not prove ownership of the linked source.
workspace.requirementsTheProviderPromisesToAddress: Requirements the provider promises to address
workspace.importAProviderSOfferJSONInstead: Import a provider's offer JSON instead
workspace.noQuotationsYetAddOneAboveOrImportA: No quotations yet. Add one above or import a signed provider offer.
workspace.compareToInspectSignaturesRemainingBudge: Compare to inspect signatures, remaining budget and the next recommendation.
workspace.recommendedNextHighestDeclaredMissingPri: Recommended next: highest declared missing priority per micro-USDC. This compares promises, not delivered quality.
workspace.paymentNotObservedNoFundsReservedOrSpent: Payment: not observed. No funds reserved or spent.
workspace.pasteSuppliedTextHighlightAnExactPassage: Paste supplied text, highlight an exact passage, then attach its provider-declared stance to a requirement. Changing the text clears its excerpts and signature.
workspace.importAProviderSDeliveryJSONInstead: Import a provider's delivery JSON instead
workspace.readEachExactExcerptYouMayDeclareASuppor: Read each exact excerpt. You may declare a supporting or refuting passage useful to your decision. This is your review, not independent truth validation, customer acceptance or payment authority.
workspace.compareTheCurrentPacketToInspectAndRevie: Compare the current packet to inspect and review deliveries.
workspace.downloadThePacketToContinueLaterOrShareS: Download the packet to continue later or share selected private fields deliberately. Only the packet can be restored; a decision receipt is a dated inspection result.
workspace.restorePrivatePacketFileJSONUpTo64KiB: Restore private packet file (JSON, up to 64 KiB)

messages.amountFormat: Use a USDC amount with at most six decimal places.
messages.validationFailed: Could not validate this change. Check the bounded fields, identifiers, signatures and exact excerpt positions. Your packet has been kept.
messages.selectionRemoved: Proposal selection removed. Compare again to inspect the remaining quotations.
messages.selectionRefused: Quotation cannot be selected now. It expired or no longer adds eligible coverage. Compare again.
messages.selectionChanged: Proposal selection changed. Compare again before selecting another quotation.
messages.restoreValidated: Packet validated. Inspect the summary before replacing this tab's work.
messages.restoreRefused: Unsupported or invalid packet. Existing work has been kept.
messages.offerSignatureAdded: Matching unsigned quotation upgraded with its provider signature. Compare to verify it.
messages.offerAdded: Quotation added. Compare to verify its signature and proposed coverage.
messages.deliverySignatureAdded: Matching unsigned delivery upgraded with its provider signature. Compare to authenticate its bytes.
messages.deliveryAdded: Delivery added. Compare to authenticate supplied bytes before recording a review.
messages.providerDataDownloaded: Private provider fields downloaded. The provider must sign the matching canonical message; importing a signature authenticates no payment.
messages.signingMessageDownloaded: Downloaded the exact signing message. This message authorizes no payment. Keep its matching unsigned packet fields unchanged.
messages.messageSigned: Provider message signed. Add it to the packet, then compare to verify the signature.
messages.messageRefused: Message was not signed. Use the provider's matching wallet and unchanged fields.
messages.restored: Restored the validated private packet. Compare again to inspect current expiry and signatures.
messages.requestPrepared: Request prepared. Export it for providers or add a quotation below.
messages.compared: Comparison recomputed from the current packet. Selection remains a proposal only.
messages.offerRemoved: Quotation and its dependent delivery/review removed.
messages.selectExcerpt: Highlight an exact passage in the supplied delivery text first.
messages.reviewRecorded: Caller review recorded. Compare again to build an updated decision receipt.
messages.deliveryRemoved: Delivery and its dependent review removed.
messages.packetDownloaded: Private plaintext packet downloaded. Store it securely; this tab has no persistent save.
messages.receiptDownloaded: Private plaintext decision receipt downloaded. Its caller reviews and unobserved payment status remain explicit.
messages.cleared: Packet and private form text cleared from this tab. Downloaded files are unchanged.
messages.fileTooLarge: Packet file exceeds the supported limit. Existing work has been kept.
messages.fileReadFailed: Could not read this packet file. Existing work has been kept.
messages.restoreCancelled: Restore cancelled. Existing work has been kept.

reasons.eligible: Signed quotation eligible for this proposal
reasons.invalid-offer-signature: Offer signature does not authenticate this quotation
reasons.no-new-proposed-coverage: Adds no currently missing proposed coverage
reasons.different-request: Quotation is bound to another request
reasons.attributed-bytes: Signature authenticates these exact supplied bytes
reasons.invalid-excerpt: Excerpt does not bind an exact usable slice
reasons.different-offer: Delivery is bound to another quotation
reasons.unbound-review: Review is not bound to an authenticated delivery

templates.question: Evidence question {number}
templates.missingRequirements: Still missing according to caller review: {requirements}
templates.restoreSummary: {offers} quotations · {deliveries} deliveries · {reviews} caller reviews · quote cap {amount}
